voice.name: Marcel - Charming Native Accent
voice.why: Odilon Marchand is a man in his fifties with a light French accent. The game has male bodies only (every Reforger head is male), so a woman's voice on his body was the maintainer's report of 2026-11-19 ("a woman's voice comes from a man"); he was Odile with the voice of Mariva. Marcel is a warm, nice, charming middle-aged man with a native French accent for narration and conversation: it welcomes the newcomer and still says hard things plainly. A different voice from the clerk (Julien), the mayor (Henri), the go-between (Cyril) and the harbour master (LaRauque). Settings tuned calm (stability 0.55) so the charm stays gentle.

greet_refuses.text: I have nothing to say to you. Please leave my cafe.

greet_wary.text: Oh. It is you. What do you need?

greet_friendly.text: Welcome back! You always bring a smile in with you. What can I do for you?

greet_regular.text: There is my favourite customer! Sit, sit. Ask me anything.

greet.text: Come in, come in. The coffee is hot. You are new here, I can tell. Nobody walks that slowly who has lived here long.

zone.text: I came out of the zone. They told us three days. Pack what you can carry, they said, and you will be back by Friday. I took the kettle and my mother's cups. That was three years ago.

move.text: When they brought us here, the town did not know what to say. So a neighbour brought bread, and nobody asked a single question. I still use the cups. Every day. Someone has to.

work.text: If you need work, ask at the post office. They always need couriers. Walk fast, keep the parcels dry, and you will be paid by the end of the day.

clerk.text: Before anything else, see the town clerk at the desk on the square. He keeps the register. A person who is not in it is no one at all, here.

handbook.text: And read the handbook. It is short. It tells you what the town expects of you, and what the police will not forgive.

bye.text: Come back when you are hungry. Or lonely. It is the same to me.

replies.ask_handbook: Is there a guide to the town?
